description: Reads a selected feed’s last update, current subscription availability (distribution_ready), editing access and configured monitoring status for a requested status check. This does not refresh, save or charge. Scope is limited to the connected account’s Smart Calendars AI feeds. No mailbox access, source-document retrieval, automatic source monitoring, scheduled PDF checks or document refresh is provided. Structured schedule content is supplied explicitly by the caller. Result links: subscription_open_url is the exact HTTPS handoff to the default calendar app via webcal; subscription_options_url provides Apple/default, Google, Outlook and copy-link choices; subscription_url is the copyable HTTPS calendar-file fallback; manage_url opens the feed dashboard. URL hosts, paths and tokens identify the returned resource and are not interchangeable. A filtered_subscription has its own links for that selection; top-level links remain unfiltered. Subscription access requires distribution_ready=true. Opening a link does not confirm a subscription; confirmation occurs in the user’s calendar app.

feed_id.description: Identity of the selected calendar returned in feed results.

name: get_feed_status
title: Check calendar status
